benchmarks.name: Consistent-Hash Routing (1K Shards)
benchmarks.description: Consistent-hash ring lookup performance with 1,024 shards (warm CPU cache)
benchmarks.notes: Very low variability indicates stable hash ring. Warm-cache assumption validated.

benchmarks.name: Two-Phase Commit Prepare
benchmarks.description: 2PC prepare() phase on single in-memory participant (mock)
benchmarks.notes: In-memory mock. Real network will add +1-5ms. State machine transition dominated.

benchmarks.name: Two-Phase Commit Commit
benchmarks.description: 2PC commit() phase on pre-prepared in-memory participant
benchmarks.notes: Fastest benchmark. Nearly branch-free in-memory commit. Exceptional stability.

benchmarks.name: WAL Append
benchmarks.description: Write-ahead log append to in-memory buffer (no fsync)
benchmarks.notes: In-memory append only. Real fsync path separate SLO (+100-1000us disk dependent).

benchmarks.name: Shard Health Check
benchmarks.description: Shard health-state lookup from local in-memory cache (64 shards)
benchmarks.notes: Most stable benchmark. Boolean vector lookup ~2 cycles. Exceptional branch prediction.

benchmarks.name: Route Lookup (64-Shard Warm)
benchmarks.description: Hash ring lookup with 64 shards (warm CPU cache)
benchmarks.notes: Smaller topology (64 vs 1K) yields 11% faster median. L1D/L2 hit patterns validated.

recommendations: No threshold changes required. All thresholds achievable and conservative.
Integrate SRG-01..SRG-06 into CI/CD pipeline with regression detection (flag >20% regression).
Re-run baselines quarterly or after major sharding changes on same hardware class.
Extend suite with network-aware 2PC and real WAL benchmarks for production scenarios.
Monitor warm-cache assumptions in production deployments.
